query: with start as ( select date_trunc($1, coalesce(now() - $2::text::interval, (select min(created_at) from files)) at time zone 'UTC') as at), events as ( select created_at as at, true as is_upload, 1 as files, size as bytes from files union all select trashed_at, false, -1, -size from files where trashed_at is not null), per_step as ( select date_trunc($1, events.at at time zone 'UTC') as step, sum(files) as files, sum(bytes) as bytes, count(*) filter (where is_upload) as uploads, sum(bytes) filter (where is_upload) as uploaded_bytes, count(*) filter (where not is_upload) as deletions, -sum(bytes) filter (where not is_upload) as deleted_bytes from events, start where events.at at time zone 'UTC' >= start.at group by 1), earlier as ( select coalesce(sum(files), 0) as files, coalesce(sum(bytes), 0) as bytes from events, start where events.at at time zone 'UTC' < start.at) select to_char(step, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') as "period!", (earlier.files + sum(coalesce(per_step.files, 0)) over (order by step))::bigint as "files!", (earlier.bytes + sum(coalesce(per_step.bytes, 0)) over (order by step))::bigint as "bytes!", coalesce(per_step.uploads, 0) as "uploads!", coalesce(per_step.uploaded_bytes, 0)::bigint as "uploaded_bytes!", coalesce(per_step.deletions, 0) as "deletions!", coalesce(per_step.deleted_bytes, 0)::bigint as "deleted_bytes!" from earlier, start, generate_series(start.at, now() at time zone 'UTC', ('1 ' || $1)::interval) as step left join per_step using (step) order by step
